title: Terms of Membership: Cancelling Marlowe & Finch Unlimited and Fee Refunds
content:
# Terms of Membership — Section 6: Cancellation and Refund of Fees

**6.1 The member's decision.** Cancelling a Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership is the member's own decision: the agent records the request and the member confirms it. A membership is cancelled only on a request for that membership whose request status is confirmed. The authority is the request record, held before the cancellation is made and tied to that same membership; a request shows what was asked (cancel at period end, or cancel with refund) and its status (pending customer confirmation, confirmed, or withdrawn).

**6.2 Cancelling during a trial.** During a trial, cancelling means turning auto-renew off; the trial runs to its end and lapses without charge, the membership expiring on the day after the trial end date.

**6.3 Full refund of an unused fee.** A paid membership cancelled no later than 14 calendar days after the latest fee charge, with no benefit used since that charge, ends at once with a full refund of that fee (an unused cancellation refund). The charge date is day zero and a cancellation on the last day still qualifies. "No benefit used since that charge" means that the membership ledger shows no benefit use dated from the latest fee charge date to the date of cancellation.

**6.4 Prorated refund on annual plans.** Otherwise, on a plan whose refund basis is unused full calendar months less benefit value, the member may end the plan at once with a refund (a prorated cancellation refund) equal to the fee charged for the period, multiplied by the unused full calendar months of the period and divided by the months in the period, less the benefit value used in the current period. That result is rounded half up to the cent and is never below 0.00. The benefit value used in the current period is the total value of the benefit uses on the ledger dated from the start of the current period to the date of cancellation.

**6.5 Plans with no refund basis.** Otherwise, on a plan whose refund basis is none, cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period, with benefits until then and no refund. The membership shows status cancellation pending with auto-renew off, and expires on the day after the current period ends.

**6.6 Withdrawal.** A scheduled cancellation can be withdrawn until the period ends; the membership returns to status active with auto-renew on.

**6.7 Refund destination and window.** Refunds go to the card charged. Every refund window under this section counts from the latest fee charge date.

## Refund basis by plan

| Plan | Refund basis after clause 6.3 does not apply |
|---|---|
| Unlimited Standard Monthly | None |
| Unlimited Student Annual | Unused full calendar months less benefit value |
| Unlimited Standard Annual | Unused full calendar months less benefit value |
| Unlimited Express Monthly | None |
| Unlimited Express Annual | Unused full calendar months less benefit value |
| Unlimited Next-Day Annual | Unused full calendar months less benefit value |

## Decision table for a confirmed request on a paid membership

| Cancelled within 14 calendar days of the latest fee charge | Benefit used since that charge | Refund basis none | Refund basis unused full months less benefit value |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | Ends at once, full refund of that fee | Ends at once, full refund of that fee |
| Yes | Yes | Ends at period end, no refund | May end at once with prorated refund |
| No | Either | Ends at period end, no refund | May end at once with prorated refund |

## Boundary of the full-refund window (hypothetical dates)

Latest fee charged on 3 March, which is day zero. A cancellation on 17 March is day 14 and qualifies; a cancellation on 18 March is day 15 and does not.

## Worked prorated refund (hypothetical period and benefit value)

An Unlimited Express Annual member charged 59.00 for a period running from 1 March to the last day of the following February cancels on 10 July, after the full-refund window. July is partly used, so the unused full calendar months are August through February: 7 of the 12 months. With benefit uses this period worth 12.50: 59.00 multiplied by 7 and divided by 12 gives 34.41666 recurring; less 12.50 gives 21.91666 recurring; rounded half up to the cent, the refund is 21.92, paid to the card charged. Had the benefit uses been worth 40.00, the result would fall below 0.00 and the refund would be 0.00.
